description: Header file defining the AddressInfo class and related components for DNS address resolution, including system call encapsulation and iteration over address info.

classes.name: AddressInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates system call to get address info and provides iteration and utility methods.

classes.name: AddressInfo::const_iterator
classes.description: Iterator over addrinfo structures within AddressInfo.

classes.name: AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Encapsulates calls to getaddrinfo and freeaddrinfo, primarily for testing.

methods.name: AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs address resolution for a given host and hints, optionally using a custom getter.

methods.name: AddressInfo::begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of address info list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of address info list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical name of the address info.

methods.name: AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addresses are localhost of the same family.

methods.name: AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from the address info.
